title.full: Subsidies for medicines not on the list

summary.text: Yes. CHAS, MG and PG cardholders can receive dollar-based subsidies, subject to their annual cap.

details.heading: Who can receive subsidies
details.body: CHAS, MG and PG cardholders can receive dollar-based subsidies of between $28 and $135 per visit. An eligible annual cap applies, based on the cardholder’s status.

details.heading: Where to get the benefits
details.body: Healthier SG benefits and subsidies are available at the enrolled Healthier SG clinic.

example_phrasings: Can I get subsidies for chronic medicines not on the list?
Are medicines outside the Healthier SG list subsidised?
Do I get help paying for chronic medicines not on the list?

sources.page_title: Under the Healthier SG Chronic Tier, can I receive subsidies for chronic medications that are not found on the Healthier SG Medication List?

quotes.text: Yes, CHAS, Merdeka Generation (MG) and Pioneer Generation (PG) cardholders can still receive dollar-based subsidies between $28 and $135 per visit, subjected to their eligible annual cap (based on their CHAS/MG/PG card status).
Healthier SG benefits and subsidies are available/accessible at your enrolled Healthier SG clinic.
